# AndroidScreencast

> AndroidScreencast is a Java desktop application to view and control an Android device from a PC over adb. It needs no client app on the phone, so it also works with a broken screen.

Features: tap and swipe gestures, typing with the PC keyboard, landscape mode, a file browser for the phone, and screen video recording. It requires Android 4.1.1 or later, because it uses `adb input tap` and `adb input swipe`.

## Docs

- [Project site](https://xsavikx.github.io/AndroidScreencast/): Description, screenshots and requirements.
- [Wiki](https://github.com/xSAVIKx/AndroidScreencast/wiki): Usage notes.
